notes: PLANNED (§A3.2) — not yet built. Continuous-audio ground-truth-event corpus for the 'hey mycroft' streaming board: long clips (many minutes to hours), each with a manifest row giving 'audio' (repo-relative path), 'onsets' (wake-word onset timestamps in seconds, empty for negative-only clips) and 'duration_s'. Isolated-clip benchmarking structurally favors clip-shaped detectors — streaming engines (openWakeWord, microWakeWord, precise-onnx; see competitor 'capabilities') can't fire on isolated clips the way they do in the live listener, and a false-accept-per-hour estimate needs hours of continuous negative audio, not seconds-long clips. Until 'TigreGotico/ww-stream-bench-hey_mycroft' is published this entry is inert: `arena assemble` already skips any dataset whose predictions_hf repo 404s (arena/cli.py:cmd_assemble logs and continues), so no runner ever tries to run this benchmark and no board is produced. Building the corpus and running the sweep is a separate, later operational task.
